title: Exclude shared midpoint recharts on changed P104 helper paths
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** Δκ = 0 on exact #7334 aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace, conditional κ = 0.00364665195644, with signed #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. Two literal checks exhaust ten changed-role single-ADD anchors. Every second helper has an adjacent ADD where the proposed four-MOVE rechart needs a MOVE.

The nearby chart-746 component does close on three roles, with ADD clocks 40834 and 41179 and six fixed paid MOVE clocks. The actual rank pairs are 3+2, 3+1 and 3+2. Its only positive paid offset would require a rank-four common chart. Exact binary calculations give a rank-five entrance union and rank-six exit intersection, excluding that offset. Moving one of the same middle role's paid legs between the two ADDs also fails exact containment at its respective outer chart. Both tested scopes are exhausted with zero unresolved.

The literal paid count is 110,519 and the productive count is 22,461. The one-component directed upper before geometry is 0.197627453181768 raw. A single added paid rank-one defeats the edit. Verified savings are zero.

## Task and overlap

This refines #7111 on canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7358 and #7361 supply the fixed-clock midpoint methods and explicitly exclude the changed roles. #7338 supplies the exact chart-746 component inventory for a different paid-fusion test. Here all six paid clocks and both signed ADDs are retained.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12:

    python3.12 -I -B research/p104-changed-shared-midpoint-bound/replay.py
    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-changed-shared-midpoint-bound

The Git-free replay reproduces nine exact receipts and rejects changed stock and price. Local registered replay, committed source and mode checks, six navigation tests, and official Git-free export and replay passed. The branch reuses exact #7257 planner repair d2e54af81f9dda6487636b79d4964a2385d89b2b. No literal candidate or complete κ replay was triggered.

## Credit and open question

#7334 supplies the exact word, #7113 the signed caller, #7298 the directed tariff, and #7337 the older mixed-role rechart. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging. A changed paid itinerary would require a fresh complete price and exact signed construction.
